description_intent: Controls whether Cortana's speech-driven interaction remains reachable on the lock screen. The secure configuration turns that voice channel off entirely while the screen is locked, leaving it available only inside an already-authenticated session.
rationale_intent: A lock screen exists to be the one gate that stands between an unattended device and anyone nearby; a voice channel that still listens and responds while locked pokes a hole through that gate, letting someone who merely has physical proximity to the device - not valid credentials - trigger actions or extract information via spoken commands. Disabling voice interaction above the lock screen keeps that gate intact so unlocking remains the only way in.
